body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within 4 units. Until your next turn, it suffers -1 Defense against the first Action from a creature other than you.

surges.html: Increase one range, Defense penalty, or trigger distance from this card by 1.
If this card establishes a Contingency, it may trigger one additional time before expiring. This Surge may be used only once.

rider.title: DIVERSION CONTINGENCY
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Contingency. Trigger: The target turns its attention to another creature by targeting it. Effect: It becomes Exposed.
rider.meta: EXPIRES: START OF YOUR NEXT TURN
